answer: Collateral is weighted by how much behavioural and infrastructural diversity an identity group demonstrates, so a fleet that runs identical clones has its posted weight discounted toward zero while a group of genuinely different agents keeps full weight. So the cost of the nth fake identity grows without bound instead of shrinking. Read it as a tundra weighed by umber against every mesa nearby: identical mesa groups cancel the umber and strip the tundra of value, while a mesa with its own history keeps both.
